name: Nickels (Three Thirteen)
description: Nickels (also known as Three Thirteen or 65) is a progressive Rummy-style card game played over 11 distinct rounds. The game starts with three cards dealt to each player and ends with thirteen cards in the final round. It is known for its shifting 'Wild Card' rule, where the rank corresponding to the number of cards dealt becomes wild for that specific round. It is a game of patience, set-building, and risk-management, where the goal is to have the lowest cumulative score.

content.text: Nickels (also known as Three Thirteen or 65) is a progressive Rummy-style card game played over 11 distinct rounds. The game starts with three cards dealt to each player and ends with thirteen cards in the final round. It is known for its shifting 'Wild Card' rule, where the rank corresponding to the number of cards dealt becomes wild for that specific round. It is a game of patience, set-building, and risk-management, where the goal is to have the lowest cumulative score.
Part of the larger Rummy family that includes Continental and Oklahoma Rummy. It gained popularity as 'Three Thirteen' in the early 20th century.
Round 1: 3 cards each. Round 2: 4 cards... Round 11: 13 cards each.
